summary: Zeros a per-element flag dword at byte offset 520 in each of four arrays of sub-resource records (element stride 132 dwords, 528 bytes). Each array is guarded by its element count and driven by its base pointer. No calls; used during render/scene cleanup.

operations.description: First array element count at this+0x1B4 is non-zero.
Zero the flag dword at byte offset 520 of each element of the first array (base pointer at this+0x1B8, element stride 132 dwords).
Second array element count at this+0x1C4 is non-zero.
Zero the flag dword at byte offset 520 of each element of the second array (base pointer at this+0x1C8, element stride 132 dwords).
Third array element count at this+0x1BC is non-zero.
Zero the flag dword at byte offset 520 of each element of the third array (base pointer at this+0x1C0, element stride 132 dwords).
Fourth array element count at this+0x1CC is non-zero.
Zero the flag dword at byte offset 520 of each element of the fourth array (base pointer at this+0x1D0, element stride 132 dwords).
Return the last array pointer / result value.
